(Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Boards/Commission/Committee meetings, listed below, that they have attended or that have occurred.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF AUGUST 22, 2017
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of August 22, 2017.
A-1 Minutes 8-22-17 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION MAKING CERTAIN FINDINGS REGARDING A PROPOSED ENERGY CONSERVATION PROJECT, IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PROVISIONS OF CALIFORNIA GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 4217.10 ET SEQ., AWARDING AN ENERGY SERVICES CONTRACT TO TANKO LIGHTING, INC., IN THE AMOUNT OF $610,374.80 FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF CERTAIN ENERGY RELATED IMPROVEMENTS TO CITY FACILITIES AND APPROVING A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH TANKO LIGHTING, INC. IN THE AMOUNT OF $58,327.50 FOR AUDIT SERVICES AND ANALYSIS SERVICES RELATED TO THE CITY ACQUISITION OF A PORTION OF THE STREET LIGHTING SYSTEM FROM SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open and conduct the public hearing; (2) adopt Resolution No. 17-5362 making certain findings regarding an Energy Services Contract; (3) award an Energy Services Contract to Tanko Lighting, Inc., in the amount of $610,374.80; (4) approve a Professional Services Agreement with Tanko Lighting, Inc. in the amount of $58,327.50; and (5) authorize the City Manager to execute the necessary agreements on behalf of the City.
B-1 Tanko Energy Savings Contract Staff Report
B-1 Tanko Energy Savings Contract Attachment A Resolution
B-1 Tanko Energy Savings Contract Attachment B CSA
B-1 Tanko Energy Savings Contract Attachment C PSA
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1436
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 17-5360 approving Warrant Register No. 1436.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1436
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF THE FIRST AMENDMENT TO THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) BETWEEN THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY FLOOD CONTROL DISTRICT AND THE CITIES OF LA PUENTE, BALDWIN PARK, COVINA, GLENDORA, INDUSTRY AND SOUTH EL MONTE FOR IMPLEMENTING THE COORDINATED INTEGRATED MONITORING PROGRAM FOR THE UPPER SAN GABRIEL RIVER WATERSHED AREA
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the First Amendment to the Memorandum of Understanding between the County of Los Angeles, the Los Angeles County Flood Control District and the cities of La Puente, Baldwin Park, Covina, Glendora, Industry and South El Monte for Implementing the Coordinated Integrated Monitoring Program For The Upper San Gabriel River Watershed Area; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the First Amendment on behalf of the City.
D-2 CIMP MOU Amendment Staff Report
D-2 CIMP MOU Amendment Attachment A Amendment
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A REQUEST FOR A FEE WAIVER FOR THE USE OF THE CITYâ€™S COMMUNITY CENTER BY BIKE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY TO OFFER FREE BICYCLE SAFETY AND REPAIR CLASSES TO THE CITY RESIDENTS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-5361 approving a request for a fee waiver for Bike SGV in the amount of $1,820 to hold free bicycle safety and repair classes at the La Puente Community Center for city residents.
D-3 Bike SGV Fee Waiver Staff Report
D-3 Bike SGV Fee Waiver Attachment A Request
D-3 Bike SGV Fee Waiver Attachment B Resolution
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A FACILITY/PARK USE AGREEMENT FOR THE SERVANTâ€™S ARMS COMMUNITY BLOCK PARTY ON SEPTEMBER 16, 2017
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Facility/Park Use Agreement for the Servantâ€™s Arms Community Block Party; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-4 Servants Arms Park Use Agreement Staff Report
D-4 Servants Arms Park Use Agreement Attachment A Agreement
D-5
UPDATE ON THE STATUS OF THE CITY'S EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS PLANS
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the update.
D-5 Hazard Mitigation and Emergency Operations Plan Update Staff Report
E.

E-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING THE REPLACEMENT OF CITY STREET NAME SIGNS
It is recommended that the City Council discuss the replacement of City street name signs and provide direction to Staff.

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
